'''Qella'tak''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Corellian Jedi|Green Jedi]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Wielding two [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in combat, he was one of the commanders of the Republic forces during the [[Battle of Corellia]].

==Behind the scenes==
Master Qella'tak was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds]]'', which added Conquest Commanders to most of the dual-faction worlds. Qella'tak is a rare NPC enemy, and his place at the [[uptown tram station]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] is frequently occupied by a generic Veteran Jedi Battlemaster.
